subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

**__Incompetent__** people keep on blaming others for their failures.
solution: The correct answer is** "inefficient."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word** 'incompetent'** means lacking the necessary skills or ability to do something. (जिसमें उच्‍च स्‍तर की कुशलता की कमी है; अक्षम, असमर्थ) • **Example**: *He is **incompetent**__ in his job.* • The word** 'inefficient'** means not achieving maximum productivity; wasteful or ineffective. (जो सर्वोत्तम रीति से काम न करे या परिणाम न दे (जिससे समय और पैसे की बरबादी हो), अकुशल, अक्षम) __ • **Example**: *Our heating system is very old and extremely **inefficient**__.* • In this context, blaming others for one's own failures is a sign of inefficiency and lack of accountability. • So, the synonym of **"incompetent"** is **"inefficient."** • The correct answer is Option 2. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1, inappropriate**, means not suitable or fitting in a particular situation. (अनुपयुक्त) • **Option 3, incongruous**, means out of place or incompatible with something else. (विसंगत, बेमेल; अनुपयुक्त) • **Option 4, inevitable**, means unavoidable or certain to happen. (जिसे घटित होने से रोका न जा सके, अवश्‍य होने वाला; अवश्‍यंभावी) 36:Tb56, The correct answer is** "Negligible."**
